text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing like standing on the dance
floor in a swimsuit while
waving a fan! This
is the joy of Bubblyland, girls! Woooo!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So this is Bubblyland!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One month ago, during a scrimmage at the
academy...

text_block_list.name: Honest Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Scarlet and Spe came in dead last?!

text_block_list.name: Well-informed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I know Scarlet recently had a fever, but I
wonder why Spe did so poorly? Actually...
She looks like she might've gained some
weight,
but...

text_block_list.name: Spe and Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Nooooo!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Huff! I can't afford to run like that anymore! I have to work even harder!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Gah! It's been a month already,
but I still
can't get out of my slump!
What should I
do, Mom?!

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Listen, you need to step back and take it
easy! From what you've
been tellin' me,
you've been training nonstop, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I-I have been resting properly! I sleep well, take relaxing baths...

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
That's not what I mean! I mean going out
and having fun with your
friends to refresh
yourself. You haven't been doing that,
have you?

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Just trust me! Give it a try.
Let go of aaall
your worries for a while and
you might just
find that it solves your problem.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I... I suppose that's true...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
B-but if I go and hang out with friends
now
before getting my running
back on track,
I'd just be slacking off!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Mama sent me something? I wonder what
it is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I hope you like the swimsuit I got you.
You've been so busy lately. Take some
time to visit the beach or pool once in a
while, dear. Love,
Mama."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wow! What a cute swimsuit! "Visit the
beach or pool," huh? I'm glad
she's
thinking of me, but I wonder why the
sudden gift.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
She's so busy with work and usually leaves
me to my own business, so
why... Oh...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(Could it be she knows how horribly I did
in our recent scrimmage?!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe she thinks I'm doing a poor job of
taking care of myself
because of that... No,
I'm overthinking things.
There's no way she could've...)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! I'll definitely win the next race and
make sure she knows I got
first place!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I can't believe I ended up arguing with Mom yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, what am I doing, wasting my time out
here on the racetrack? I've
gotta focus! I'm
going to nail training today!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I had a feeling she'd be here!
Um, would
you like to run with me?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I haven't been able to get back into
shape since the scrimmage the
other day,
no matter what I do. Has it been the same
for you, Spe?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Y-yeah! The more I think about it, the
more confused I get about my
running
form. But everything was fine before..."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I know what you mean. I'm in the same
boat. That's why I thought challenging
someone to a race might help me get back
into stride,
so..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: (Clouds of dust, pounding footsteps, someone ahead of me... Yes, this is what it's like to race! It's all coming back to me!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(All right! We're almost at the fourth
corner! All I've gotta do now is
work these
arms and legs and overtake Scarlet!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, why aren't I speeding up?! How am I
supposed to move my
arms again? Just
what's my form supposed to be when I
run?!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(Ah! The gap between us is going to widen
even more if I don't hurry!
I have to change
gears... How do I do that again?!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: (Oh nooo, what should I do?!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Gah!

text_block_list.name: Spe and Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My goodness...
Their forms are all over the
place. They must've lost
all sense of their
own running styles.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling they might've forgotten
some other things, too, in
their panic...
Hmm, if that's the case...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Spe! I know a place that'll get you
out of your rut and back in
fantabulous
form. Come with me to Bubblyland!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Th-there's a place like that?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You betcha! I heard from Fuji that you and
Scarlet haven't been doing
well lately, so I
thought we could all go.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I've rented a car and invited our sports
fanatic, Tickezo, to join us
too, so we're all
ready to rock 'n' roll!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That said,
Scarlet passed up the offer! She
said she's already got a
training regimen
locked down. Haha!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: What about you? You down?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(If this training facility that
Maruzensky's recommending really can
help people get
out of their slumps, then maybe it'll work
for me too!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: C-count me in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Spe and Tickezo, you two'd better hold on
tight! You're gonna
experience the most
amazing magic at Bubblyland!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Magic?! I'm going to that Bubbly
whatchamacallit place too! No one
can
stop me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And now, having arrived...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So this is Bubblyland!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wait! I-is it actually possible to do any
training here?!
